Name: Hezron, Son of Reuben
Summary: Hezron was a son of Reuben and a grandson of Jacob, named among the family that went into Egypt.
KeyStory: Hezron is named among Reuben's four sons — a different Hezron from the son of Pharez.
RelatedPeople: Reuben; Hanoch, Son of Reuben; Phallu; Carmi
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
